note: The one authored file of the capture contract (CC7). The type tree (15 domains, 61 categories, 324 type ids), the suitability profile rows, the layer and offer-class rules, and the marks, links, sources and display overrides per node. Change a kind's fields here, run `node core/bin/capture.ts build`, review the generated diff. See research/method/capture-contract.md section 8.

lift.note: altitude_m is A: the altitude is the top station's (capture contract 2.7.2).

ferrata.note: operated changed from always to flag (capture contract 2.3): most Dolomites via ferratas are self-guided routes.

river.note: A river or creek: the lake row with the water fields asked and the paddle extension A. Draft for design review (capture contract 2.3).

motor_water.note: Jet ski, water ski, towed tube, flyboard. The boat row plus the driver rule. Draft for design review.

dive.note: Snorkel and scuba. Water fields R; medical R. Draft for design review.

surf.note: Surf, kite and wind lessons. Draft for design review.

climb.note: Crag, multipitch, bouldering, indoor wall and guided climbing. The ferrata row without the ferrata extension. Draft for design review. effort.drivers.distance_km holds the pitch or route height; gain_m is only for the approach.

canyoning.note: Guided canyoning (v, a and class grades). Draft for design review. on_site_min is the duration of the descent.

play.note: Playground, splash pad, indoor play, snow play, farm play. A node may add an extension (snow.play adds snow, splash_pad adds water). Draft for design review.

theme_park.note: Theme, amusement and water parks, adventure parks. Ride limits sit on each variant. Draft for design review.

access.note: Trailhead, parking, stop, dock. Access places carry no suitability except accessible parking and the walk. Draft for design review. Stations also carry the facilities and altitude of the place a lift or train arrives at.

amenity.note: Picnic area, rest area, public toilet, visitor information, EV charger, fuel. Draft for design review.
